description: T-056: the floor sweep of the daily cleanup. Compared by record diff after forcing both servers' cleanup (record_diff); the steps after the cleanup are new-side only because the original's BBS drops every caller for its cleanup. Needs a cleanup trigger on both sides; written, not run.

mask.why: every direction name carries a random capital letter and a backspace, rewritten each slow cycle: `nJ\borth`
HP/mana in the prompt depend on earlier fights and regen

steps.note: items on the floor of the start room

OPERATOR: force the cleanup on both servers now (MBBSEmu: its nightly cleanup; silvermere: EngineInput::DailyCleanup, or game.cleanup.at). The original's BBS logs every caller off for its cleanup, so the original side drops this connection here; the new side must stay connected.
the floor after the sweep: hidden, not deleted. New side only: the original's caller was dropped by the cleanup.
the swept items are hidden. New side only: the original's caller was dropped by the cleanup.

record_diff.what: after the cleanup, compare the stored records on both sides: the start room's items/hiditems/coins (WCCMP001 1:2140 vs rooms + room_state), and Aldric's lifemins, sesstime and evil (WCCUSERS vs characters)
record_diff.orig: export with vendor/play/mmud_data.py export after the cleanup
record_diff.applied: not yet: the harness has no record diff (T-040); compare by hand
record_diff.why_mask: on the original side the cleanup's caller drop is a hang-up: room, map and ST_HUNGUP change there and not on the new side; hp is masked as well in case PUNHUP is not pinned

options.why: the original's BBS drops every caller for its cleanup, which is a hang-up in the realm; PUNHUP=NONE keeps the record diff free of the random hang-up penalty (HP, items). The room move and ST_HUNGUP still happen on the original side, so the record_diff masks room and status.
options.applied: not yet: the harness has no per-scenario options; set them on both servers before running
